title: Normalized representative and comparison data for two-injective Hom
statement: For small ringed sites and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define Representatives(H,DH) to consist of isomorphisms DH(QK,QI) ≅ QH(K,I) for every complex K and K-injective I, natural in both chain maps, and inverting quasi-isomorphisms in the two variables. For the actual derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and actual product-total sheaf Hom [def-pur-hom-complex], RingedRepresentatives additionally fixes these isomorphisms by the canonical coefficient target-resolution augmentation. Such normalized representatives exist, by the already proved augmentation construction. Define Comparison for exact additive U preserving products, internal sheaf Hom, and K-injectives to consist of source and target normalized representatives, a chain natural isomorphism pinned on every product projection to the given sheaf-Hom comparison, and a derived natural isomorphism represented by it with the two exact-functor localization-factor legs. Define StandardModel to consist of a complex bifunctor, its degreewise product projections, the standard differential d_I f minus (-1)^n f d_K, and the component map equations. For the native Frobenius-fixed module category [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework, def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category], define the existing underlying-Hom bifunctor and forgetKInjective proof, and TwoInjectiveHomModel containing the finite-subextension coefficient interpretation, standard source and target models, the native-to-standard sign isomorphism with (n,p) component (-1)^(np), its naturality, the normalized native derived-Hom identification, and the normalized chain and derived forgetting comparisons. These are precisely the existing definitions, with no existence assertion for the final Comparison or native TwoInjectiveHomModel.

source.place: Sections 0A8X and 08J7, Lemma 0A95; componentwise and localization assembly from steps 4–5 of lem-sf-ringed-forget-two-injective-hom.

proof.text: Retain every field and definition from the existing module verbatim. They specify actual product projections, standard differentials, the canonical target-resolution augmentation, and both localization-factor legs, rather than choosing unknown data. The native record only specifies the native coefficient, sign, naturality and forgetting equations; its existence theorem is separate.

Retain the already proved ringedRepresentatives construction: augment the target to its functorial K-injective resolution. For a K-injective target the augmentation induces a quasi-isomorphism of Hom complexes by the universe companion of RHom invariance. Invert its localization and compose the canonical derived-Hom factor. Naturality follows by cancelling this isomorphism, and the normalization is the canonical augmentation equation.

Retain the existing forgetKInjective proof, which specializes the exact orbit-induction/right-adjoint criterion to the native fixed-pair category. Universe-shrinking supplies the countable coproduct and exactness instances used by the already existing criterion.

proof_origin.place: Formal categorical assembly of the product-total Hom and K-injective models in Sections 0A8X and 08J7.
